fix.delta: prv: weakest model sov6-logic-v3-light at 0.031 despite a prior det/swarm fix pattern. Root cause: 31/32 items UNPARSED (not wrong) — the light model emits verbose/refusal-style text on privacy-classification items instead of the exact label, and deepseek-r1:8b (20/32 unparsed) emits chain-of-thought that the exact-label parser rejects. The 0.031 floor is a format/transport artefact, not a capability measurement. Honest fix: add a format-coercion pass on Privacy/PrvBench — strict answer-with-EXACTLY-ONE-label preamble plus a single retry-on-unparsed, and instrument per-item parse logs so genuine misclassification is separated from parse-noise before the floor is trusted or quoted.
